title: Windows 11 26H2 更新完反馈
content: The Windows 11 26H2 update enhances system performance and user interface customization. File Explorer now opens almost instantly, and the taskbar can be minimized to maximize application window space. The right-click context menu allows direct custom rotation of images and supports user-defined entries. These improvements eliminate the need for third-party tools like PowerToys for basic image management and menu customization.

title: 《余波》是一部对1945年后德国社会进行深刻剖析的作品
content: “Aftermath” is a detailed examination of German society in the aftermath of 1945. The work provides a critical analysis of the nation’s conditions and experiences following World War II, offering insights into the period's social dynamics and challenges. This study contributes to the historical understanding of post-war Germany.
